senses.en: Using someone else's words or ideas as your own without credit.

ex.en: The syllabus says plagiarism can mean a failing grade.
ex.zh: 教学大纲写明抄袭可能导致课程不及格。

ex.en: Changing a few words does not prevent plagiarism if the structure is still copied.
ex.zh: 如果结构仍是抄来的，只改几个词也不能避免抄袭。

tip: 学术写作里，引用是 citation，抄袭是 plagiarism。

senses.en: to make someone eager to do something
to provide the reason for someone's actions

ex.en: The lab instructions say to motivate someone to do something.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求激励某人做某事。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to motivate someone to do something.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们激励某人做某事。

col: motivate someone to do something｜激励某人做某事
tip: 常用motivate sb to do；by后可接动机。

senses.en: the feeling of being annoyed
soreness or discomfort in a part of the body

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about skin irritation.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于皮肤刺激的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss skin irritation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论皮肤刺激的材料。

col: a source of irritation｜令人恼火的事物
tip: 既可指情绪上的恼怒，也可指皮肤等受到刺激。

senses.en: A large hole in the ground
An area where racing cars stop for servicing
The hard central part of certain fruits

ex.en: I copied a deep pit into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把深坑抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a deep pit.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得深坑这个例子。

col: a pit stop｜赛车进站检修
tip: 维修区常用the pits；果核义主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: The study of knowledge, existence, reality, and moral values
A set of beliefs that guides actions and decisions

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about moral philosophy.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于道德哲学的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects moral philosophy with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把道德哲学和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 指学科通常不可数；指某套理念可用a philosophy。

senses.en: A statement about what is likely to happen in the future.
To say what will probably happen, using available information.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on weather forecast.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论天气预报。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of weather forecast.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得天气预报这个例子。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常用forecast，也可用forecasted。

senses.en: A legally protected name or symbol identifying a company's products.
A distinctive feature strongly associated with someone or something.
To register a name or symbol for legal protection.

ex.en: Office hours began with registered trademark.
ex.zh: 答疑从注册商标开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of registered trademark.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得注册商标这个例子。

tip: 商标用trademark；版权用copyright，保护对象不同。

senses.zh: 亲切友善的；易于交谈的
senses.en: friendly and easy to talk to
easy to understand or enjoy without special knowledge

ex.en: Our professor circled friendly and approachable on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了友善且平易近人的。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of friendly and approachable.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得友善且平易近人的这个例子。

col: friendly and approachable｜友善且平易近人的
an approachable style｜浅显易懂的风格
tip: 形容人时重在容易交谈、让人敢于求助。

senses.en: To let someone or something go free or escape.
To make information or a product available to the public.
The act of freeing or publishing; something newly made available.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to release a report.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须发布报告。

ex.en: The passage says students who can release a report follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够发布报告的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: release可指释放，也可指公开发布报告或产品。

senses.en: making you feel affection, sympathy, or gentle sadness
putting a hand or another body part against something

ex.en: Our professor circled a touching story on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了感人的故事。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a touching story.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得感人的故事这个例子。

tip: touching形容事情感人；touched形容人受到感动。

senses.en: someone with little experience in a particular activity

ex.en: Our professor circled a complete novice on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了完全的新手。

ex.en: The reading connects a complete novice with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把完全的新手和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示某方面的新手，常用a novice at/in。

senses.en: a place where young children are cared for
a place where young plants are grown for sale
a room in a home for a baby or young child

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on plant nursery.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论苗圃。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around plant nursery.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕苗圃展开说明。

tip: 英式英语中at nursery常指在托儿所。

senses.en: A person with deep knowledge of an academic subject.
A student awarded money to study because of their abilities.

ex.en: I copied a leading scholar into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把杰出学者抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a leading scholar.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得杰出学者这个例子。

tip: scholar通常指学者，不是普通学生。

senses.en: A large public meeting supporting a cause or expressing opinions.
To gather people together to support someone or something.
To regain strength or improve after a difficult period.

ex.en: Office hours began with rally support.
ex.zh: 答疑从争取支持开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around rally support.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕争取支持展开说明。

col: rally around someone｜团结起来支持某人
tip: rally support for表示“为……争取支持”。

senses.en: The quality of staying similar in behaviour, standards, or results.
How thick, firm, or smooth a substance is.

ex.en: Our professor circled maintain consistency on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了保持一致性。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss maintain consistency.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论保持一致性的材料。

col: consistency in quality｜质量的稳定性
a smooth consistency｜细腻均匀的质地
tip: 表示某方面的一致性用 consistency in。

senses.en: a mention of someone or something
consultation for information, or a source used in writing
a recommendation or someone who recommends you for work

ex.en: The professor explained reference with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了提及。

ex.en: Students who can explain reference usually follow the rest of a lecture on academic research.
ex.zh: 能解释提及的学生，通常跟得上一节关于学术研究的讲座。

tip: reference to表示提及；for reference表示供参考。

senses.en: The belief that good things will happen.

ex.en: Office hours began with cautious optimism.
ex.zh: 答疑从谨慎乐观开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cautious optimism.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论谨慎乐观的材料。

col: optimism about the future｜对未来的乐观态度
tip: 不可数名词；对某事乐观常用optimism about。

senses.en: A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour.
A basic truth explaining how something works.

ex.en: I copied basic principle into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把基本原则；基本原理抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects basic principle with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把基本原则；基本原理和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: basic principle｜基本原则；基本原理
tip: 勿混principal：它可指“主要的”或“校长”。

senses.en: to put a plan or decision into action
a tool used for a particular task

ex.en: The assignment is to implement a policy, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先实施政策，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to implement a policy and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你实施政策，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 动词重音在首音节；名词末音节读/mənt/。

senses.en: To make certain that something happens or is true

ex.en: The assignment is to ensure safety, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先确保安全，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The passage says students who can ensure safety follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够确保安全的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: ensure接名词或that从句；insure指投保。

senses.en: A biological group whose members can usually breed with one another.

ex.en: Our professor circled endangered species on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了濒危物种。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around endangered species.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕濒危物种展开说明。

tip: 单复数同形：one species，many species。

senses.en: How much something happens or how far it reaches.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about the full extent of.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于……的全部程度或范围的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the full extent of.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕……的全部程度或范围展开说明。

col: to some extent｜在某种程度上
the full extent of｜……的全部程度或范围
to a large extent｜在很大程度上
tip: 表示“在某种程度上”用to some extent。

senses.en: a sharp, curved nail on an animal's foot
a jointed gripping part on a crab or similar animal
to scratch or pull at something with claws or fingers

ex.en: The professor explained claw with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了爪。

ex.en: A reading on the natural sciences uses claw when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了爪。

col: claw at something｜使劲抓挠某物
tip: claw是尖爪；paw指猫狗等动物的整个脚掌。

senses.en: the early morning when daylight first appears
the beginning of a new period or development
to become understood, or to begin growing light

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize dawn in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出黎明。

ex.en: A reading on the natural sciences uses dawn when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了黎明。

col: from dawn to dusk｜从早到晚
the dawn of a new era｜新时代的开端
dawn on someone｜使某人开始明白
tip: It dawned on me that…表示“我开始明白……”。

senses.en: The way parents care for and teach a child

ex.en: Office hours began with a strict upbringing.
ex.zh: 答疑从严格的家庭教育开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used a strict upbringing to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用严格的家庭教育来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: a strict upbringing｜严格的家庭教育
a sheltered upbringing｜备受呵护的成长经历
a privileged upbringing｜优越的成长环境
tip: 指童年养育及家庭教育，不等同于学校教育。

senses.en: A unit measuring heat energy or energy supplied by food.

ex.en: The textbook introduces calory intake in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了热量摄入。

ex.en: The reading connects calory intake with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把热量摄入和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: calory是罕用变体；现代写作请用calorie。

senses.en: a title introducing a section within a longer piece

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on clear subheading.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论清晰的小标题。

ex.en: A campus survey used clear subheading to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用清晰的小标题来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 指文章内部的分标题，不指影视字幕。

senses.en: to obtain something from a particular source
to come or develop from something else

ex.en: I heard the lecturer derive pleasure from during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时从……获得乐趣。

ex.en: The reading asks you to derive pleasure from and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你从……获得乐趣，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: derive A from B指从B获得A；derive from指源于。

senses.en: Sharing a situation, activity, or status with someone
A man or boy, referred to informally
A member of a learned society or certain academic institutions

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on research fellow.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论研究员。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around research fellow.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕研究员展开说明。

tip: 形容词只放名词前，如my fellow students。

senses.en: Having little depth from the surface to the bottom
Lacking serious thought, understanding, or emotional depth
Taking only a small amount of air into the lungs

ex.en: Office hours began with shallow water.
ex.zh: 答疑从浅水开始。

ex.en: The author returns to shallow water when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了浅水。

tip: 水浅或思想肤浅都可用shallow，反义词为deep。

senses.en: to eat growing grass, or let animals feed on it
to scrape skin slightly or touch something while passing
a small injury where skin has been scraped off

ex.en: The lab instructions say to graze on grass.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求吃草。

ex.en: The reading asks you to graze on grass and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你吃草，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 动物吃草可说graze on grass；graze cattle指放牛。

senses.en: To become visible or known after being hidden.
To develop or become important and noticeable.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to emerge from.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须从……中出现。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to emerge from.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得从……中出现。

col: emerge as a leader｜崭露头角成为领导者
tip: 不及物动词；常用emerge from或emerge as。

senses.en: Not believing or acting as though you are better than others.
Simple or low in social position, wealth, or importance.
To make someone feel less proud or important.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about humble origins.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于卑微的出身的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of humble origins.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得卑微的出身这个例子。

col: in my humble opinion｜依我拙见
tip: 谦逊是humble；不要与“羞辱”humiliate混淆。

senses.en: The work of organising and running an institution or business.
The people responsible for managing a government or organisation.
The act of giving medicine or treatment to someone.

ex.en: Our professor circled public administration on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公共行政。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of public administration.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得公共行政这个例子。

tip: 指管理工作时通常不可数；指一届政府时可数。

senses.en: a condition involving dependence on alcohol and difficulty controlling drinking

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on treatment for alcoholism.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论酒精依赖的治疗。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss treatment for alcoholism.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论酒精依赖的治疗的材料。

col: treatment for alcoholism｜酒精依赖的治疗
recover from alcoholism｜从酒精依赖中康复
tip: 指酒精依赖这一疾病，不指嗜酒的人。

senses.en: feeling that something good is likely to happen
suggesting that a good result is likely
someone hoping to succeed in a competition or particular career

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a hopeful sign.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于令人看到希望的迹象的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a hopeful sign to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用令人看到希望的迹象来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: hopeful about the future｜对未来充满希望
a hopeful sign｜令人看到希望的迹象
tip: 人满怀希望用hopeful；事物有前景常用promising。

senses.en: A woodwind instrument with a single reed and finger-operated keys.

ex.en: Our professor circled a clarinet solo on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了单簧管独奏。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a clarinet solo.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕单簧管独奏展开说明。

col: a clarinet player｜单簧管演奏者
tip: 演奏乐器通常说play the clarinet，注意加the。

senses.en: a bird often associated with peace
someone who favours peaceful solutions rather than military action

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a white dove.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论白鸽。

ex.en: A campus survey used a white dove to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用白鸽来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: a symbol of peace｜和平的象征
a political dove｜政治上的主和派人士
tip: 指主和派时，与主张强硬手段的hawk相对。

senses.en: giving satisfaction or a sense of achievement
providing substantial financial benefits

ex.en: The textbook introduces financially rewarding in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济回报丰厚的。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around financially rewarding.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕经济回报丰厚的展开说明。

tip: 多指带来满足感；强调赚钱可加financially。

senses.en: To order someone not to do something or disallow it

ex.en: The lab instructions say to forbid someone to do something.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求禁止某人做某事。

ex.en: The passage says students who can forbid someone to do something follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够禁止某人做某事的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: forbid someone to do something｜禁止某人做某事
forbid someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事
tip: 过去式forbade，过去分词forbidden；可接动名词。

senses.en: Better in quality or performance than another
Someone with a higher position or rank than you
Behaving as though you are better than other people

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about immediate superior.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于直属上司的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around immediate superior.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕直属上司展开说明。

tip: 比较时用superior to，不用superior than。

senses.en: a feeling of very great surprise

ex.en: Our professor circled express astonishment on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了表示惊讶。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of express astonishment.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得表示惊讶这个例子。

col: to someone's astonishment｜令某人惊讶的是
tip: 通常不可数；to one's astonishment表示令某人惊讶的是。

senses.en: A change made to improve something or suit a purpose.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about minor modification.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于小幅修改的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around minor modification.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕小幅修改展开说明。

tip: 可数时指具体改动，不可数时指修改过程。

senses.en: a sale where an item goes to the highest bidder
to sell something to the person offering the most money

ex.en: The textbook introduces online auction in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了网上拍卖。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around online auction.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕网上拍卖展开说明。

tip: at auction可不加冠词；auction off表示拍卖掉。

senses.en: Strong protective covering worn in battle or fitted to vehicles.
Military vehicles with protective covering, considered as a group.

ex.en: Our professor circled a suit of armour on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一套盔甲。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a suit of armour.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得一套盔甲这个例子。

col: a suit of armour｜一套盔甲
tip: 英式armour，美式armor；通常不可数。

senses.en: deliberately inflicted severe pain, or an extremely distressing experience
to deliberately cause severe physical or mental suffering

ex.en: Our professor circled psychological torture on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了精神折磨。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around psychological torture.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕精神折磨展开说明。

col: subject someone to torture｜使某人遭受酷刑
tip: 语气很强；日常可夸张表达煎熬，不只是普通不适。

senses.en: enough to meet a need or achieve a purpose

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sufficient evidence.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论充分的证据。

ex.en: A campus survey used sufficient evidence to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用充分的证据来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 常用sufficient for或sufficient to do，语气较正式。

senses.en: a small soluble case containing medicine that you swallow
a small enclosed compartment carrying people or equipment in space

ex.en: I copied space capsule into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把太空舱抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to space capsule when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了太空舱。

tip: 药物capsule有外壳；tablet通常是压制成的药片。

senses.en: The ability to understand something, especially language or ideas.

ex.en: I copied reading comprehension into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把阅读理解抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of reading comprehension.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得阅读理解这个例子。

tip: 通常不可数；comprehensive意为“全面的”。

senses.en: a short memorable phrase promoting an idea, group, or product

ex.en: Our professor circled catchy slogan on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了朗朗上口的口号。

ex.en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of catchy slogan.
ex.zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得朗朗上口的口号这个例子。

tip: slogan用于宣传；motto多指座右铭或行为准则。

senses.en: wanting more money or possessions than one needs
wanting to eat more food than one needs

ex.en: The textbook introduces greedy for money in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了贪财的。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around greedy for money.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕贪财的展开说明。

col: a greedy investor｜贪婪的投资者
tip: 常含贬义；greedy for后接金钱、权力等所贪之物。

senses.en: A large room used for formal social dancing

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a hotel ballroom.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于酒店舞厅的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a hotel ballroom.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕酒店舞厅展开说明。

tip: ballroom dancing 指交谊舞，不是夜店蹦迪。

senses.en: Protected from direct sunlight.
Made darker with colour or drawn marks.

ex.en: I copied shaded area into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把遮阴区域；阴影区域抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used shaded area to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用遮阴区域；阴影区域来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

col: shaded area｜遮阴区域；阴影区域
tip: 也可作shade的过去式或过去分词，表示遮挡阳光。

senses.en: A large, strong bag used for storing or carrying things.
To dismiss someone from their job.
Dismissal from a job, used in the phrase the sack.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a sack of potatoes in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一大袋土豆。

ex.en: A campus survey used a sack of potatoes to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用一大袋土豆来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: a sack of potatoes｜一大袋土豆
sack someone for misconduct｜因行为不当解雇某人
tip: 表示解雇时常用于英式口语；正式用dismiss。

senses.en: The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body.
A person, especially when describing their character.
Expressive popular music combining gospel and rhythm and blues.

ex.en: Office hours began with heart and soul.
ex.zh: 答疑从全心全意开始。

ex.en: The reading connects heart and soul with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把全心全意和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a kind soul｜心地善良的人
not a soul｜一个人也没有
tip: not a soul意为一个人也没有，不是没有灵魂。

senses.en: A solid whose particles form a regular, repeating pattern.
Clear quartz used in jewellery and decorative objects.

senses.zh: 水晶玻璃；水晶玻璃制品
senses.en: High-quality glass, or objects made from it.

ex.en: The textbook introduces crystal structure in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了晶体结构。

ex.en: The reading connects crystal structure with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把晶体结构和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: crystal clear｜清澈透明的；十分清楚的
tip: crystal clear既可形容水清澈，也可表示意思十分清楚。

senses.en: to choose someone for a position by voting
to choose to do something

ex.en: The assignment is to elect a president, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先选举总统，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to elect a president.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得选举总统。

col: elect someone to office｜选举某人任职
elect to do something｜选择做某事
tip: elect sb chair 中职务前常不加冠词。

senses.en: Available in large amounts, often more than needed.

ex.en: The textbook introduces abundant resources in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了丰富的资源。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss abundant resources.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论丰富的资源的材料。

col: abundant wildlife｜丰富的野生动植物
tip: abundant强调数量充足；名词搭配an abundance of。

senses.en: Made a device or process start working.
Treated to increase chemical activity or ability to absorb substances.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to activated carbon.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何活性炭。

ex.en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to activated carbon.
ex.zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们活性炭。

tip: 是activate的过去式和过去分词；不表示性格活泼。

senses.en: The visible features of an area of land.
The overall conditions and features of a particular field.
To improve land by arranging plants and other outdoor features.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on rural landscape.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论乡村景观。

ex.en: A campus survey used rural landscape to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用乡村景观来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: landscape可数，指一片景观；scenery通常不可数。

senses.en: Magnetic tape used to record moving images and sound.
To record moving images and sound onto magnetic tape.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an old videotape.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一盘旧录像带的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects an old videotape with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把一盘旧录像带和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an old videotape｜一盘旧录像带
videotape a performance｜用录像带录制演出
tip: 指磁带录像；现代数字录像通常用video或record。

senses.en: Having no hope, or offering no chance of success.
Very bad at doing something.

ex.en: Office hours began with a hopeless situation.
ex.zh: 答疑从无望的处境开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a hopeless situation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论无望的处境的材料。

col: hopeless at cooking｜极不擅长做饭
a hopeless case｜无可救药的人或事
tip: “不擅长做某事”用hopeless at doing。

senses.en: Having a name that is unknown or kept secret.
Lacking distinctive features that make something easy to recognize.

ex.en: I copied anonymous donor into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把匿名捐赠者抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to anonymous donor when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了匿名捐赠者。

tip: 匿名是anonymous；保密是confidential，含义不同。

senses.en: A person or country that supports another.
To join with someone for a shared purpose.

ex.en: I copied a close ally into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把亲密盟友抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a close ally.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论亲密盟友的材料。

tip: 名词重音通常在前；动词通常读/əˈlaɪ/。

senses.en: A person who is not a member of the armed forces
Relating to people or activities outside the armed forces

ex.en: Office hours began with civilian population.
ex.zh: 答疑从平民人口开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of civilian population.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得平民人口这个例子。

tip: civilian指非军人；公务员通常是civil servant。

senses.en: Telling the truth or accurately describing what happened.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a truthful account.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于如实的叙述的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a truthful account.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论如实的叙述的材料。

col: be truthful about something｜如实说明某事
tip: truthful指诚实或如实；“真正的朋友”用true。

senses.en: a school where students live as well as study

ex.en: I wrote boarding school on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把boarding school和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up boarding school while discussing evidence about academic research.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了寄宿学校。

col: attend boarding school｜就读寄宿学校
send a child to boarding school｜送孩子去寄宿学校
tip: boarding指食宿；寄宿学校既提供教学也提供住宿。

senses.en: having little chance of harm, loss, or failure

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize low-risk in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出低风险的。

ex.en: Students who can explain low-risk usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释低风险的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

tip: low-risk表示风险较低，不等于完全无风险。

senses.en: to move faster or make something happen more quickly

ex.en: I heard the lecturer accelerate growth during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时加快增长。

ex.en: The reading asks you to accelerate growth and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你加快增长，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 既可指车辆加速，也可指进程加快；可及物或不及物。

senses.en: not producing the result that is wanted

ex.en: I copied prove ineffective into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把结果证明无效抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of prove ineffective.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得结果证明无效这个例子。

tip: ineffective指无效果；inefficient指效率低。

senses.en: work, especially physical work, or the workers who perform it
to work hard, often with considerable physical effort
the process of giving birth to a baby

ex.en: Our professor circled manual labor on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了体力劳动。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss manual labor.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论体力劳动的材料。

tip: labor为美式拼写，英式作labour。

senses.en: Too willing to trust because of limited experience.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about politically naive.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于政治上幼稚的的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects politically naive with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把政治上幼稚的和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常含缺乏经验、容易轻信之意，并非单纯褒义。

senses.en: to become larger or make something larger
to add more details to an explanation or discussion

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to expand rapidly.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须迅速扩大。

ex.en: The passage says students who can expand rapidly follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够迅速扩大的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: expand access to｜扩大获得……的机会
expand on an idea｜进一步阐述想法
tip: “详述”用expand on/upon；扩大某物可直接接宾语。

senses.en: Discuss terms with others to reach an agreement.
Successfully move past an obstacle or along a difficult route.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to negotiate an agreement.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求协商达成协议。

ex.en: The reading asks you to negotiate an agreement and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你协商达成协议，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: negotiate an agreement｜协商达成协议
negotiate a bend｜顺利通过弯道
tip: 与某人谈判用with；也可直接接agreement。

senses.en: soldiers collectively, or an organized military unit
an organized group of people or a group of animals
to walk somewhere together as a group

ex.en: Our professor circled a troop of monkeys on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一群猴子。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a troop of monkeys.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得一群猴子这个例子。

col: a troop of monkeys｜一群猴子
tip: 表示士兵常用复数troops；演员团用troupe。

senses.en: relating to volume measured in cubes, or shaped like a cube

ex.en: I copied cubic metre into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把立方米抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cubic metre.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论立方米的材料。

tip: cubic用于体积单位；square用于面积单位。

senses.en: a man with a high noble rank or historical authority
a title used to address or refer to God

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a powerful lord.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论有权势的领主。

ex.en: A campus survey used a powerful lord to explain a pattern in historical change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用有权势的领主来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。

col: a powerful lord｜有权势的领主
lord of the manor｜庄园领主
lord it over someone｜对某人作威作福
tip: 指上帝用the Lord；置于姓名前作头衔也大写。

senses.en: To put someone or something in contact with an influence
To reveal something hidden, especially wrongdoing
To uncover something previously hidden or protected

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to expose corruption.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何揭露腐败。

ex.en: The passage says students who can expose corruption follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够揭露腐败的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: expose someone to risk｜使某人面临风险
expose children to music｜让儿童接触音乐
tip: expose A to B表示使A接触B，B不一定有害。

senses.en: a lack of knowledge or awareness about something

ex.en: Office hours began with admit ignorance.
ex.zh: 答疑从承认不了解开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss admit ignorance.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论承认不了解的材料。

col: in ignorance of｜在不知……的情况下
tip: 不可数；常用ignorance of/about表示对某事不了解。

senses.en: someone who owns a bank or holds a senior banking position

ex.en: I copied investment banker into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把投资银行家抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around investment banker.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕投资银行家展开说明。

tip: 通常指银行家或高级职员，不泛指银行柜员。

senses.en: A warm feeling of love or fondness for someone or something.

ex.en: I copied a sign of affection into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把喜爱的表示抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sign of affection.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕喜爱的表示展开说明。

col: deep affection for｜对……的深厚感情
a sign of affection｜喜爱的表示
tip: 通常不可数；对某人的喜爱用affection for。

senses.en: a person's general attitude towards life or a situation
the likely future situation
the view from a particular place

ex.en: The textbook introduces positive outlook in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了积极的心态。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss positive outlook.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论积极的心态的材料。

tip: 态度常接on；前景常接for，如outlook for growth。

senses.en: a sign suggesting that something exists or may happen

ex.en: The textbook introduces a clear indication in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了明确的迹象。

ex.en: The author returns to a clear indication when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了明确的迹象。

col: give an indication of｜显示出……的迹象
tip: 常用 indication of sth 或 indication that 从句。

senses.en: A small green plant growing in soft patches on damp surfaces.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a patch of moss in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一片苔藓。

ex.en: The author returns to a patch of moss when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一片苔藓。

col: a patch of moss｜一片苔藓
tip: 常作不可数名词；lichen指地衣，不等于moss。

senses.en: The act of agreeing to receive or do something offered.
Willingness to welcome someone or regard something as suitable.
Recognition that a situation is real and must be faced.

ex.en: I copied widespread acceptance into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把广泛认可抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used widespread acceptance to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用广泛认可来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: acceptance of an offer｜接受提议
tip: 通常不可数；acceptance of后接接受的事物。

senses.en: Weapons and military equipment.
The body parts extending from the shoulders to the hands.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about arms trade.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于武器贸易的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss arms trade.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论武器贸易的材料。

tip: 表示武器时用复数arms；an arm通常指一条手臂。

senses.en: A general rise in prices that reduces money's purchasing power.
The process of filling something with air or gas.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about the rate of inflation.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于通货膨胀率的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of the rate of inflation.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得通货膨胀率这个例子。

col: the rate of inflation｜通货膨胀率
keep pace with inflation｜跟上通胀
tip: 经济语境指物价普遍上涨，不只某件商品涨价。

senses.en: Someone who translates spoken or signed communication between languages.
A program that reads and executes code directly.

ex.en: I copied a qualified interpreter into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把合格的口译员抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a qualified interpreter.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得合格的口译员这个例子。

col: a qualified interpreter｜合格的口译员
a sign language interpreter｜手语翻译员
tip: interpreter 通常做口译；translator 通常做笔译。

senses.en: a long pole with a sharp point, used as a weapon
to push a pointed object into or through something

ex.en: I copied wooden spear into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把木矛抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss wooden spear.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论木矛的材料。

col: spear a piece of food｜叉起一块食物
tip: spear是长矛，不是枪械；动词可指用叉子戳起食物。

senses.en: to cry with short, sudden breaths
a short, broken breath or sound made while crying

ex.en: The professor asked us to sob quietly.
ex.zh: 教授让我们轻声抽泣。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to sob quietly.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得轻声抽泣。

tip: 过去式sobbed，进行式sobbing，均双写b。

senses.en: an early version of writing that may be changed
to write an early version of a document

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about first draft.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于初稿的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around first draft.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕初稿展开说明。

tip: 表“草稿”英美均用draft；穿堂风英式用draught。

senses.en: either bone structure in the mouth that holds the teeth

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on lower jaw.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论下颌。

ex.en: The reading connects lower jaw with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把下颌和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: jaw指颌骨或颌部；chin仅指脸部最下方的下巴。

senses.en: Someone who avoids animal foods and usually other animal products.

senses.zh: 纯素的；不含动物制品的
senses.en: Using or containing no animal products.

ex.en: Our professor circled a vegan diet on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了纯素饮食。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a vegan diet.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕纯素饮食展开说明。

col: go vegan｜开始采用纯素生活方式
tip: vegan不吃蛋奶；vegetarian通常可吃蛋奶。

senses.en: to leave something out, deliberately or accidentally

ex.en: The assignment is to omit details, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先省略细节，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to omit details.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得省略细节。

col: omit something from a report｜从报告中删去某项内容
tip: 过去式omitted，进行式omitting，均双写t。

senses.en: relating to farming, including growing crops and raising animals

ex.en: The textbook introduces agricultural land in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了农业用地。

ex.en: A campus survey used agricultural land to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用农业用地来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

tip: 形容词，常修饰 land、production、machinery。

senses.en: A person who oversees other people's work or activities.
An academic who guides a student's research.

ex.en: Our professor circled immediate supervisor on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了直属主管。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss immediate supervisor.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论直属主管的材料。

tip: 职场中指主管；英国大学中也常指研究导师。

senses.en: In a way that shows approval, confidence, or optimism.
With certainty and no doubt.
Used to strongly emphasise a description.

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to positively identify.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习确切辨认。

ex.en: Students who positively identify are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够确切辨认的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: positively可强调语气，也可表示积极态度或确定性。

senses.en: the connected events that make up a story
a small piece of land used for a particular purpose
secretly plan something harmful or dishonest

ex.en: The textbook introduces a complex plot in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了复杂的情节。

ex.en: A campus survey used a complex plot to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用复杂的情节来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

col: a plot of land｜一小块土地
a garden plot｜一小块菜园地
plot against someone｜密谋对付某人
tip: plot指情节；作动词还可表示标绘数据。

senses.en: the act of beginning to use an idea or method
the legal process of becoming a child's parent

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about widespread adoption.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于广泛采用的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used widespread adoption to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用广泛采用来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: adoption是采用或收养；adaptation是适应或改编。

senses.en: Strong trust or confidence in someone or something.
Belief in a god, or a particular religious system.

ex.en: Office hours began with religious faith.
ex.zh: 答疑从宗教信仰开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around religious faith.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕宗教信仰展开说明。

col: in good faith｜真诚地；善意地
tip: 表示对某人或某事有信心，用have faith in。
